description: This file defines the IEventNotificationScheduler interface and its implementation EventNotificationScheduler, which manages scheduling and canceling event notifications stored in a database. The class uses Entity Framework Core for database operations and handles notification prioritization, serialization, and logging.

classes.name: IEventNotificationScheduler
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for scheduling and canceling event notifications asynchronously.

classes.name: EventNotificationScheduler
classes.description: Implementation of IEventNotificationScheduler that uses a database (via AppDbContext) to manage notification scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellation.

methods.name: RescheduleForEventAsync
methods.description: Schedules a notification for a given CalendarEvent, canceling previous pending or failed notifications.

methods.name: CancelForEventAsync
methods.description: Cancels all pending, failed, or processing notifications associated with a specific event ID.
